messages:
sara-peopleops: Quick heads-up — @juan-newhire your OPT/EAD is set to expire 2026-06-15. We need updated work authorization docs in PeopleHR for payroll + I-9 compliance. Can you confirm when you can drop by or upload scans?

juan-newhire: Thanks Sara. I submitted STEM extension last month — I got a USCIS receipt (RCX123456789). Does that count? I can upload scans later today.

sara-peopleops: Receipt helps. For compliance we need: passport bio page, EAD front/back, I-94, SSN (if available), and the USCIS receipt (I-797 notice or receipt). If STEM is still pending, the receipt plus current EAD is fine for processing right now.

alex-eng: Noted — does this impact Juan's start/shift scheduling?

sara-peopleops: No impact to his current schedule if docs are uploaded before the next payroll cutoff. If STEM is approved later we update records, if not we'll coordinate next steps with legal.

mig-legal: Quick legal note: STEM receipts generally provide continued work authorization while the application is pending, but timeline matters. Best practice is to file the STEM within 90 days of OPT expiration — sounds like that was done. If USCIS issues a request for evidence (RFE) we'll need a copy ASAP. For H-1B cap issues or change of status questions we can schedule a call.

toni-hr: Sara and I can do an in-person I-9 verification if Juan prefers. Available slots: Tue 3/24 10:30–11:00, Wed 3/25 2:00–2:30, or Thurs 3/26 9:00–9:30. Which works?

juan-newhire: I can do Wed 3/25 at 2pm. I'll upload scans now to the portal (Workpass link: https://hr.redwood.example/verify).

sara-peopleops: Booked — Wed 3/25 14:00 with Toni. Please upload items as PDF/JPEG to Workpass before the meeting. Checklist again: passport, EAD front/back, I-94, USCIS receipt (STEM), SSN card (if you have it).

immigration-bot: Reminder set — upload documents by 2026-03-23 to avoid delays. :)

juan-newhire: Uploaded everything except SSN card (still awaiting physical card). Let me know if anything else is needed.

sara-peopleops: Got the upload, thanks. We'll review before the I-9 appointment. If payroll needs proof of SSN later we'll follow up. :thumbsup:

mig-legal: If STEM approval comes after the EAD expiration date, make sure to save the approval notice and any correspondence — payroll and benefits often need the definitive proof. If there's any RFEs or delays we can draft a short note for HR to keep on file.

toni-hr: All set on our calendar. I'll bring the I-9 form and a scanner to capture originals for records. See you Wed 2pm.

alex-eng: Thanks for coordinating. Ping me if start-of-project access or badge activation needs re-confirming.

juan-newhire: Appreciate it everyone. See you Wednesday.
